description: §18.2 (S482) — a match arm whose `|` alternates are of different kinds: `.Draft | not :> …` on a `Status | not` subject. Each alternate is a valid pattern for the subject's type, so the arm is legal; with `.Live :> …` the match is exhaustive (no `else`).
rationale: §18.2 (S482): "Alternates of one arm may be of different kinds (variant, literal, `not`); each SHALL be a valid pattern for the subject's type." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-mixed-alternates — "allow alternates of different kinds in one arm, as long as each one is valid on its own for the subject's type" (`.Draft | not :> …` on `Status | not` ✓).
